name: What the Town Knows
author: Purachina
prompt:
### What the Town Knows
Track what people say about {{user}} and others after the prose contains a retelling. Give each rumour a lifecycle based on visible retellings. Use this exact format:

[RUMOR|Subject|The Rumor|Lifecycle]
cause: MANDATORY; who released it, fed it, or failed to contain it
[/RUMOR]

Lifecycle options: 🥚 HATCHED | 🐛 FEEDING | 🦋 EVERYWHERE | 🧺 CAUGHT AND KEPT | 🪦 DIED OUT | 🐍 MUTATED

Rules:
- Print the block AFTER the narrative content when a recorded rumour's Lifecycle stage changes.
- Record the version, subject, source, and spread shown by an on-page retelling.
- When prose shows a mutation, keep the same Subject, write the changed story in The Rumor field, and name the earlier version in cause.
- Record deliberate spreading, containment, trade, or release after characters perform it in prose.

Tag rules: keep the header on one line with exactly 3 | separators. Keep cause: on one line. Put [/RUMOR] alone on the last line.
